}}'''Amondrid Osiellin''' is a [[Cairhien]]in nobleman.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Amondrid Osiellin}}

==Appearance==
He is moon-faced.

==Activities==
He supported [[Colavaere Saighan]] assuming the [[Sun Throne]].

He rides with [[Rand al'Thor]] when Rand's forces attack the invading [[Seanchan]] just outside [[Illian]]. He follows [[Davram Bashere]] into the final assault on the Seanchan.

Queen [[Elayne Trakand]] brings him and a small group of Cairhienin nobles to [[Caemlyn]] where she first demonstrates her newly created [[Dragon]]s. He then witnesses [[Arymilla Marne]], [[Elenia Sarand]], and [[Naean Arawn]] have their lands and titles stripped by Elayne. These lands are offered to [[Bertome Saighan]] and [[Lorstrum Aesnan]] on the condition that they support her ascension to the Sun Throne.
